scripts.check: bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.check:release: bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run check && bun run build:gui && bun test packages/web-client examples/erp-web/test
scripts.build:agent: bun run check:agent-native && bun build apps/agent/src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 --windows-hide-console --outfile dist/windows/impresora-pos-agent.exe && bun apps/agent/scripts/package-native-helper.ts
scripts.build:gui: bunx vite build --config apps/gui/vite.config.ts && bun build apps/gui/electron/main.ts apps/gui/electron/preload.ts --outdir apps/gui/dist-electron --target=node
scripts.test:gui: bun test apps/gui/electron/agent-client.test.ts apps/gui/electron/agent-launcher.test.ts apps/gui/e2e/lifecycle.spec.ts apps/gui/e2e/security.spec.ts apps/gui/src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.test.tsx apps/gui/e2e/first-run.spec.ts apps/gui/e2e/first-run.render.spec.ts
